title: Binary black hole scattering with generic spins
summary: In this Letter, we confront high-order post-Minkowskian (PM) predictions for generic-spin black-hole scattering with numerical-relativity (NR) simulations for the first time, targeting improvements for eccentric and precessing waveform modelling. We extract azimuthal and polar scattering angles from NR and relate them to the PM spin-kick observable. We introduce asymptotic Euler angles for unbound motion and derive their geometric relation to the scattering angles.
